answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the yarrow to sunk effort, uses the tundra as an corroborating signal, then requires a walnut before any payout.
